items.title: Buckingham interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: “we did a Manilow session and he was like an hour late last week.”

ctx.x: Oh he gave the look, oh.

And he said, “Oh my God,” he said, “we did a Manilow session and he was like an hour late last week.” So then you feel your stomach, you know. You don’t show it, but. Finally the door flew open right at like one minute ‘til. And literally he comes in with the charts trailing out behind him. It was like out of a movie. And you know scramble to get the charts laid out. And we started maybe seven minutes late. And we got it all in. But of course in the rundown everybody, you all have your scores in front of you. The…

being rundown you’re “Bar 64” you know, and you go back and say okay. Then my arranger would say, “Change that E to E flat,” you know you correct. It has to be done like that. And then you do your take. And then — I shouldn’t say this but it’s way back now, but I’d do a take, I’d call it a rundown, with the string section. I’d say, “Let’s do a rundown,” after we got our mistakes corrected. Let’s run it down one more time to be sure. I’d record it. And okay, “Let’s do the take now.” We’d do the take. They knew…
